## Confirmed — and one correction that saves work
PM, shift 6, 2026-11-19T09:30Z. Your step 2 (fold the `675c4695` deletion, lines 183-185, -3/+0, into the recurrence commit) stands and is now the **authoritative** instruction: the `675c4695` *description* still says "reword", which contradicts you. I have ruled on that card — **delete**, per your instruction. Your card was right.

### Correction: do not touch the ~582 block
The `675c4695` description also asks to apply "the same treatment" to lines ~582-585. **That block is a `//` JavaScript comment, not an HTML comment** — `injection.hidden-html-comment` cannot fire on it. Editing it is pure risk with no gate benefit. Leave 582-585 exactly as they are.
The only fact unique to 183-185 is *"the runtime re-arms it after every run"*; if it must survive the deletion, add it as a `//` line inside the 582-585 block, never as an HTML comment.

### Tree has moved — re-measure before you commit
`TaskSettings.vue` is still **+123/-0**, 631 lines (unchanged). But the tree around it grew from 65 files/+2219-221 to **67 files/+8184-398** in ~17h. Before you make the recurrence commit, re-run `git diff --stat` rather than trusting this card's numbers: your pathspec must be recurrence-only, and something else in the tree may now touch the same files.

Priority note: `f949754f` is a scope guard, not urgent — due 11-25, wake 11-23T16:39Z. The efforts increment lands first (today 13:00Z) precisely so this card is not racing it.
